rooms.name: Main Entrance Lobby
rooms.notes: Grand circular entrance lobby aligned with building centroid; glass curtain-wall frontage; provides access to retail units, lifts and staircore. Vastu — northeast orientation preferred for main entry in Bangalore.

rooms.name: Ground Floor Reception / Concierge
rooms.notes: Central concierge serving all building users; staffed desk with visitor management. NBC Group F (retail/commercial) reception norm applied.

rooms.name: Café / Coffee Shop
rooms.notes: Retail café unit on perimeter arc; full-glass curtain-wall façade giving street presence. NBC Group F retail minimum applied; area sized for seating of ~40 covers.

rooms.name: Art Gallery / Exhibition Space
rooms.notes: Open-plan gallery for rotating art/product exhibitions; curved perimeter wall follows circular building geometry; natural daylighting via full-height glazing.

rooms.name: Stock Room / Back-of-House Store
rooms.notes: Shared back-of-house storage for café and gallery consumables; no external glazing required.

rooms.name: Circulation Corridor (Ring)
rooms.notes: Annular ring corridor following circular plan geometry; connects all ground-floor tenancies and core. Minimum clear width 1.8 m (NBC ambulatory + wheel-chair); total area reflects full arc length.

rooms.name: Male Toilet Block
rooms.notes: NBC Part 9 – 3 WCs + 3 urinals + 2 washbasins for estimated 100 male occupants on ground floor.

rooms.name: Female Toilet Block
rooms.notes: NBC Part 9 – 4 WCs + 2 washbasins for estimated 100 female occupants on ground floor.

rooms.name: Accessible / Unisex Toilet
rooms.notes: NBC / Harmonized Guidelines for persons with disability; 1.8 m × 2.5 m clear internal min; grab rails, turning radius 1500 mm.

rooms.name: Ground Floor Pantry / Kitchenette
rooms.notes: Shared prep/pantry for café support and building staff; NBC hygiene separation from toilets maintained.

rooms.name: Ground Floor Electrical / BMS Room
rooms.notes: Houses main LV switchboard, BMS panels, and metering for all tenants. MEP routing required (brief fidelity hint). Rainwater harvesting header tank connection stub-out here.

rooms.name: Security / Guard Room
rooms.notes: 24-hour manned security post adjacent to main lobby; direct sightline to entrance and vehicle drop-off.

rooms.name: Surface Drop-off / External Forecourt
rooms.notes: Circular driveway forecourt; accessible drop-off bay; connects to basement ramp (B1 level underground parking for 30 cars). Permeable paving + rainwater collection point.

rooms.name: Perimeter Planter / Outdoor Threshold
rooms.notes: Exterior green threshold band wrapping gallery arc; native planting for urban heat-island mitigation; also serves as rainwater catchment plinth edge.

response.floor_summary: Ground floor of the circular mixed-use tower accommodates a grand entrance lobby, concierge reception, street-facing café, art gallery with perimeter glazing, back-of-house support spaces, accessible public toilets, a BMS/electrical room, security post, and a landscaped external forecourt with drop-off, collectively activating the public retail-and-gallery programme of the building.
